summary: CheerPlanner AI Designer 4-feature upgrade (Reference/Logo upload, Variations 1-4, Transparent background, Edit/Tweak) — both backend and frontend fully verified. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (all 9 legacy iter115 + 5 new: variations=2+transparent returns 2 valid PNGs & image_base64 alias, variations clamping to MAX=4, edit_image returns new design, reference_images (data-URL prefix stripped) + logo accepted, ref-only-no-prompt accepted with default prompt). Frontend on mobile viewport 390x844 as demo@cheerplanner.app on /team/ai-designer: all new testIDs present (ai-designer-ref-add, ai-designer-logo-add, ai-designer-var-1..4, ai-designer-transparent, ai-designer-tweak, ai-designer-apply-edit). Full flow: selected 2 variations + toggled transparent ON, generated → loading indicator shown, image rendered, 2 variation thumbs shown (variation-0/1), tapping variation-1 changed the large preview; Save → button flips to 'Saved'; Tweak 'make it navy and add sparkles' + apply-edit → new dark/navy sparkly star rendered; Library opened, saved design shown, delete cleanup succeeded (library empty). Non-staff (sophia.athlete) still 403 at backend. No mocked APIs — real OpenAI GPT-Image-2 calls throughout.
action_items: OPTIONAL (carryover from iter115, still applies): /team/ai-designer route has no client-side guard for non-staff — direct URL renders the UI (backend still 403s any call). Consider redirecting non-team_access users away from this route.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_designer.py L77-83: base64.b64decode inside _decode_inputs silently drops any input whose decode fails via bare `except Exception: continue`. If a client sends corrupted image bytes the request may still succeed with fewer inputs than expected; consider logging a warning so bad payloads are debuggable.

ai_designer.py L98-100: request rejects only when BOTH prompt and input_images are empty; when only reference/logo is provided a default prompt is silently substituted. This is intentional per spec but not documented in the endpoint contract — worth a one-line docstring note.

ai-designer.tsx L98: front-end validation requires either prompt OR (refImage/logo); however when the user has only a `tweak` value + an existing `image` (edit flow) the guard is skipped correctly via applyEdit, but a stale `refImage`/`logo` will still be sent on every tweak — a subtle behavior worth surfacing in the UI (e.g. show pill 'Uses logo & ref' next to Tweak).

ai-designer.tsx L149-158: web branch of deleteDesign runs without a confirm dialog (silent delete). Users tapping the trash icon by accident lose designs immediately. Consider window.confirm on web parity with the native Alert.
ai-designer.tsx L137-147: openDesign sets saved=true optimistically before the fetch resolves; if the fetch fails the user sees 'Saved' state with no image. Minor UX polish.
seed_data_creation: Test created 1 design via frontend Save and cleaned it up via UI delete; pytest also created & deleted its own record. Demo account library ends empty. No other demo data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_ai_designer.py (14 cases, ~2min due to 4 real OpenAI generate calls incl. one 2-variation and one edit). New testIDs on /team/ai-designer: ai-designer-ref-add / ai-designer-ref-clear, ai-designer-logo-add / ai-designer-logo-clear, ai-designer-var-1..4, ai-designer-transparent (Switch), ai-designer-variation-<i> (strip), ai-designer-tweak, ai-designer-apply-edit. Login: fill [data-testid=login-email-input] + [data-testid=login-password-input] then click [data-testid=login-submit-button]. Generate wall time observed ~15-45s on preview; keep timeouts >=170s. On web, ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync opens the browser file dialog which Playwright can drive via page.set_input_files if reference/logo upload UI needs to be exercised (was not exercised here — main-agent note said it may be tricky; Add buttons + presence + generation-without-images were confirmed, and reference+logo payload was covered at the API layer).
